file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for Lancaster University Medicine and Surgery MBChB A100. This file preserves the supplied official-source research, cycle labels, implementation mapping and known unknowns; executable rules live in data/universities/lancaster-a100.json.

research_scope.evidence_intake_basis: Lancaster University A100 ApplySmart research supplied by the user on 2026-07-05
research_scope.notes: The 2027 course page confirms the course and AAA offer. Pool thresholds remain cycle-labelled 2026-entry historical guidance because no 2027 thresholds were supplied.

evidence_classification_policy.official: A rule or statistic attributed by the supplied research to a first-party Lancaster University source.
evidence_classification_policy.historical_guidance: A cycle-labelled past or in-progress-cycle value used only to position interview competitiveness, never as a future guarantee.
evidence_classification_policy.research_derived: A transparent ApplySmart mapping of official evidence that is not itself a Lancaster rule.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish the fact safely enough for execution.
evidence_classification_policy.intake_caveat: The user designated the completed Markdown research as authoritative. Source classifications preserve its official-source evidence log.

route_limited_blockers: The 2027 pool-specific UCAT thresholds are not yet published.
The 2026 cycle does not yet have final interviewed and offer-holder UCAT averages.
The IB route has no separately published total-points figure.
The annual country-specific international qualification fact sheet was not reproduced in the supplied research.
MMI station count, total duration, scoring scale and tie-breakers are unpublished.
readiness.summary: Official evidence supports scoped A100 eligibility and UCAT-only historical interview guidance for Home standard, verified Home contextual/WP and International school-leaver pools.

related_routes.name: Medicine and Surgery with a Gateway Year

applicant_groups.definition: Home A100 applicants without the contextual/WP adjustment.
Home applicants whose contextual/WP eligibility is verified by Lancaster.
International applicants ranked in a separate pool with four published places for 2026 entry.
Graduates use A100 and their applicable fee-status UCAT pool, but have distinct academic requirements and no current contextual/WP eligibility.
applicant_groups.manual_review_reason: Degree subject, 65% transcript average and prior A-level branch must all be verified.

science_options: Biology, Chemistry and Physics separately at 6/B
Combined Science: Trilogy as two GCSEs at 6-6/BB

cross_qualification_conditions.subject: Biology
cross_qualification_conditions.rule: If not studied at A-level, IB Higher Level or Advanced Higher, GCSE Biology must be at least 7/A.

cross_qualification_conditions.subject: Chemistry
cross_qualification_conditions.rule: If not studied at A-level, IB Higher Level or Advanced Higher, GCSE Chemistry must be at least 7/A.

gcse.resits: Not considered without clearly evidenced exceptional circumstances.
gcse.igcse: Accepted; the English requirement accepts only English as a First Language IGCSE.

alternative_offer.additional_qualification_required: A fourth AS/A level or EPQ

practical_endorsement.evidence_gap: Not stated as a requirement in the supplied official evidence.

resit_route.exceptional_first_attempt_range: BBB to CCC with evidenced exceptional circumstances

higher_route.timing: One sitting after one year of study

advanced_higher_route.timing: One sitting after one year of study

scottish.manual_review_reason: The shared executor does not enforce subject-specific Higher grades and sitting timing together.

international_baccalaureate.manual_review_reason: No total-points threshold is published and the engine must not invent one.

ucat_and_sjt.ranking_role: sole numeric interview-shortlisting factor after academic eligibility

historical_thresholds.home_borderline_pool: Up to 10 points below each Home threshold, selected using prior academic performance

scale_policy.reason: The supplied research explicitly warns that the cycle tables must not be compared directly without conversion, and supplies no evidence that a linear conversion is psychometrically equivalent.

selection_model.stage_1: Academic eligibility gate: GCSE points and core subjects plus the applicable post-16 route.
selection_model.stage_2: Applicants who pass Stage 1 and the SJT filter are ranked by UCAT cognitive total within the applicable Home standard, Home contextual or International pool.
selection_model.stage_3: Applicants with the highest combined MMI station scores receive offers.
selection_model.stage_4: Fitness-to-practise, occupational health, immunisation and enhanced DBS requirements apply.
selection_model.architecture_mapping: Existing ucat_ranking model with separate applicant pools, contextual adjustment and SJT exclusion.

domains: responses to written or video prompts
interview.scoring: Each station is scored by a trained interviewer against defined criteria; the overall score combines station scores.

automatic_criteria: Care experienced, care leaver, or Local Authority care experience of at least three months
other_criteria_categories: low-income household evidence, including means-tested benefits, Free School Meals, and 16-19 bursary / EMA evidence
school disadvantage evidence, including lower attainment or lower progression to higher education
effects: ABB rather than AAA final offer condition after successful interview

guaranteed_interview.programme: Lancaster Access Programme: Access to Medicine

implementation_notes: The captured widening-participation list is not exhaustive.
Area or postcode-derived evidence requires Lancaster-specific interpretation; no executable IMD or SIMD cutoff is published in the research pack.
The ABB contextual offer is a post-interview offer condition and not a Stage 1 academic eligibility route.

special_policies.deferred_entry: Applicants select their preferred entry year on UCAS; post-offer deferral requests must be made in writing before the end of July.
special_policies.transfers: Not accepted into any year from other degrees or medical schools, apart from narrow serious-personal-circumstances restart-at-Year-1 exceptions.
special_policies.work_experience: Relevant experience is expected and reflected on; it need not be clinical shadowing and may be verified after interview.
special_policies.personal_statement: Not scored or ranked; used for interview preparation and to flag resit or discontinuous-study circumstances.
special_policies.reference: Used to support academic, resit, study-gap and contextual evidence.

evidence_gaps.impact: Historical guidance only; no live 2027 cutoff decision.
evidence_gaps.handling: Use cycle-labelled 2026 /2700 thresholds as medium-confidence guidance.

evidence_gaps.impact: No 2026 interviewed or offer-holder average can define an upper guidance boundary.
evidence_gaps.handling: Do not invent an interview-likely or strong-choice boundary.

evidence_gaps.impact: The route cannot be automatically decided without inventing a total.
evidence_gaps.handling: Record HL and SL requirements and require review.

evidence_gaps.impact: Unlisted country-specific qualifications cannot be automatically decided.
No practical-endorsement gate can be enforced.
Station count, total duration, score scale and tie-breaks cannot be shown as fixed facts.
evidence_gaps.handling: Store only published format, approximate station duration and domains.

historical_band_policy.realistic: From the applicable published 2026-entry Home pool threshold up to 29 points above it.
historical_band_policy.ambitious: Within the published 10-point Home borderline interval.
historical_band_policy.high_risk: Below the threshold and, for Home pools, below the borderline interval.
historical_band_policy.interview_likely: ApplySmart-derived confidence interpretation: 30 to 99 points above the applicable published 2026-entry Home pool threshold.
historical_band_policy.very_strong_interview_potential: ApplySmart-derived confidence interpretation: at least 100 points above the applicable published 2026-entry Home pool threshold.

do_not_infer: Do not treat a 2026-entry threshold as the 2027 live cutoff.
Do not linearly convert legacy /3600 UCAT statistics into /2700 prediction boundaries.
Do not present ApplySmart-derived bands above the historical threshold as official Lancaster categories or current-cycle cutoffs.
Do not infer a practical-endorsement requirement.
Do not infer an IB total-points requirement.
Do not infer country-specific international qualification equivalence.
Do not infer MMI station count, score scale or tie-break rules.
Do not apply contextual/WP adjustments to graduates or International applicants.
Do not convert MMI-only offer evidence into an offer prediction.
